# Load Libraries and Datasets
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet)
access <- read_csv("data/processed/10th Percentile Access Tracts.csv")
prscrb <- read_csv("data/processed/Providers with Geographic Location.csv")
ruca <- read_excel(
  "C:/Users/mackw/Box/2.Mackenzie/PD Prescribers (Mapping)/GitHub/PD-Prescribers-Mapping/data/raw/RUCA-codes-2020-tract.xlsx",
  sheet = "RUCA2020 Tract Data",
  skip = 1)
```

# Make sure provider data is a sf object
```{r}
prscrbr_sf <- prscrb %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326)
tracts <- tigris::tracts(cb = TRUE, year = 2024)
prscrbr_reduced <- prscrbr_sf %>%
  st_join(
    tracts %>%
      filter(GEOID %in% access$GEOID) %>%
      select(GEOID) %>%
      st_transform(st_crs(prscrbr_sf)),
    join = st_within,
    left = FALSE
  )
```

# Overview of This Data
```{r}
prscrbr_reduced %>% ggplot(aes(x=beneficiaries)) + geom_histogram() + facet_wrap(~Provider_Type)

prscrbr_reduced %>% filter(is.na(beneficiaries)) %>% count(Provider_Type)
```

# Leaflet Map
```{r}
# Summarize providers within each access tract
provider_tracts <- prscrbr_reduced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    providers = n_distinct(NPI),
    provider_types = paste(
      sort(unique(Provider_Type)),
      collapse = "<br>"
    ),
    Beneficiaries = if (all(is.na(beneficiaries))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(beneficiaries, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create national tract map data
contiguous_states <- c(
  "AL", "AZ", "AR", "CA", "CO", "CT", "DE", "FL",
  "GA", "ID", "IL", "IN", "IA", "KS", "KY", "LA",
  "ME", "MD", "MA", "MI", "MN", "MS", "MO", "MT",
  "NE", "NV", "NH", "NJ", "NM", "NY", "NC", "ND",
  "OH", "OK", "OR", "PA", "RI", "SC", "SD", "TN",
  "TX", "UT", "VT", "VA", "WA", "WV", "WI", "WY"
)

map_tracts_us <- tracts %>%
  filter(STUSPS %in% contiguous_states) %>%
  mutate(
    in_access = GEOID %in% access$GEOID
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    provider_tracts,
    by = "GEOID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    providers = ifelse(
      is.na(providers) & in_access,
      0,
      providers
    )
  )

map_tracts_us_simple <- map_tracts_us %>%
  st_transform(5070) %>%
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 1000, preserveTopology = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

tracts_background <- map_tracts_us_simple %>%
  filter(!in_access)

tracts_access <- map_tracts_us_simple %>%
  filter(in_access)

states_us <- states(cb = TRUE, year = 2024) %>%
  filter(STUSPS %in% contiguous_states) %>%
  st_transform(5070) %>%
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 500, preserveTopology = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(4326)
```

```{r}
# Provider color scale
provider_pal <- c(
  "#9ECAE1",
  "#6BAED6",
  "#4292C6",
  "#2171B5",
  "#084594"
)
# Create national Leaflet map
 leaflet() %>%
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = paste0(
     "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/light_all/",
      "{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png?key=cb1_4c1a_1_8e8c2c646cf8dbd9af06a7fb"
    ),
    attribution = "&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors &copy; CARTO"
  ) %>%
  
  addPolygons(
    data = tracts_background,
    fillColor = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    color = "gray",
    weight = 0.3
  ) %>%
  
  addPolygons(
    data = tracts_access,
    fillColor = ~ifelse(
      providers == 0,
      "#C96B6B",
      provider_pal(providers)
    ),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = "gray",
    weight = 0.3,
    popup = ~lapply(
      paste0(
        "<b>GEOID:</b> ", GEOID,
        "<br><b>Total Providers:</b> ", providers,
        "<br><b>Total Reported Beneficiaries:</b> ",
        ifelse(
          is.na(Beneficiaries),
          "Suppressed (<11)",
          Beneficiaries
        ),
        "<br><br><b>Provider Types:</b><br>",
        provider_types
      ),
      htmltools::HTML
    ),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 1.5,
      color = "black",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # State boundaries
  addPolygons(
    data = states_us,
    fill = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1.5,
    opacity = 1
  )
```

# Static Map 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

provider_pal <- c(
  "#9ECAE1",
  "#6BAED6",
  "#4292C6",
  "#2171B5",
  "#084594"
)

provider_map <- ggplot() +
  
  # Background tracts
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_background,
    fill = "white",
    color = "gray80",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  # Access tracts
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_access,
    aes(fill = providers),
    color = "gray70",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  # State boundaries
  geom_sf(
    data = states_us,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Provider count scale
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = provider_pal,
    values = scales::rescale(c(1, 5, 9, 13, 18)),
    limits = c(1, 18),
    breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15, 18),
    na.value = "#C96B6B",
    name = "Number of Providers"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Carbidopa/Levodopa Providers in Low Neurologist-Access Tracts"
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

provider_map
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(patchwork)

# Provider color scale
provider_pal <- c(
  "#9ECAE1",
  "#6BAED6",
  "#4292C6",
  "#2171B5",
  "#084594"
)

# Common map theme
map_theme <- theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 13,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )


# -----------------------------
# 1. Full map
# -----------------------------

map_full <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_background,
    fill = "white",
    color = "gray80",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_access,
    aes(fill = providers),
    color = "gray70",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = states_us,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = provider_pal,
    values = scales::rescale(c(1, 5, 9, 13, 18)),
    limits = c(1, 18),
    breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15, 18),
    na.value = "#C96B6B",
    name = "Number of Providers"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = ""
  ) +
  
  map_theme


# -----------------------------
# 2. Tracts WITHOUT providers
# -----------------------------

map_no_providers <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_background,
    fill = "white",
    color = "gray80",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_access %>% filter(providers == 0),
    fill = "#C96B6B",
    color = "gray70",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = states_us,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "No Providers"
  ) +
  
  map_theme


# -----------------------------
# 3. Tracts WITH providers
# -----------------------------

map_providers <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_background,
    fill = "white",
    color = "gray80",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_access %>% filter(providers > 0),
    aes(fill = providers),
    color = "gray70",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = states_us,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = provider_pal,
    values = scales::rescale(c(1, 5, 9, 13, 18)),
    limits = c(1, 18),
    breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15, 18),
    name = "Number of Providers"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "≥1 Provider"
  ) +
  
  map_theme


# -----------------------------
# Combine maps
# -----------------------------

provider_panel <- 
  map_full /
  (map_no_providers + map_providers) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1, 1)
  )

provider_panel

ggsave(
  "figures/Provider_Availability_Panel.png",
  plot = provider_panel,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```


# RUCA Codes
```{r}
map_tracts <- map_tracts_us %>%
  left_join(
    ruca,
    by = c("GEOID" = "TractFIPS23")
  )

prscrbr_reduced <- prscrbr_reduced %>%
  left_join(
    ruca,
    by = c("GEOID" = "TractFIPS23")
  ) 
prscrbr_reduced <- prscrbr_reduced%>%
  mutate(
    RUCA_reduced = case_when(
      PrimaryRUCA <= 3 ~ "Metropolitan",
      PrimaryRUCA > 3 & PrimaryRUCA <= 6 ~ "Micropolitan",
      PrimaryRUCA > 6 & PrimaryRUCA <= 9 ~ "Small Town",
      PrimaryRUCA == 10 ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    RUCA_reduced = factor(
      RUCA_reduced,
      levels = c(
        "Metropolitan",
        "Micropolitan",
        "Small Town",
        "Rural"
      )
    )
  )

prscrbr_reduced %>% count(Provider_Type, PrimaryRUCA)

provider_plot <- prscrbr_reduced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(RUCA_reduced, Provider_Type) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = RUCA_reduced,
      y = n,
      fill = Provider_Type
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = "Area Type",
    y = "Number of Providers",
    fill = "Provider Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```

```{r}
tracts_access <- tracts_access %>%
  left_join(
    ruca %>%
      select(
        TractFIPS23,
        PrimaryRUCA
      ),
    by = c("GEOID" = "TractFIPS23")
  ) 
tracts_access <- tracts_access %>%
  mutate(
    RUCA_reduced = case_when(
      PrimaryRUCA <= 3 ~ "Metropolitan",
      PrimaryRUCA <= 6 ~ "Micropolitan",
      PrimaryRUCA <= 9 ~ "Small Town",
      PrimaryRUCA == 10 ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    RUCA_reduced = factor(
      RUCA_reduced,
      levels = c(
        "Metropolitan",
        "Micropolitan",
        "Small Town",
        "Rural"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ruca_provider_map <- ggplot() +
  
  # Background
  geom_sf(
    data = tracts_background,
    fill = "white",

    ),

    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
```
